description: Orbital hub above Proxima and the largest orbital by population in any system. Proxima Habitat is a bustling and cosmopolitan settlement the size of a small city-mall. In many ways this is the beating heart of human space.
name: Proxima Habitat

description: This is Tycho's principal orbital settlement and gateway to the system. Spectacular views of Tycho's chaotic skies are tempered by the heavy radiation shielding.
name: Tycho Habitat
short_desc: Industrial orbital above a restless, resource-rich world.

description: Bela's main orbital settlement is crammed with hotels, casinos, and cocktail bars. It's busy, but most tourists carry on down the gravity well where warm oceans and bright sunsets await.
name: La Bella Vista Habitat
short_desc: Resort orbital city above La Bella Vista's warm oceans.

description: The largest settled orbital in the system, Irasia Habitat is a bustling trade port that never sleeps. Manufacturing and cilivian traffic comes and goes ceaselessly and the concourses are swift and crowded.
name: Irasia Habitat
short_desc: Busy commercial orbital on a major trade spine.

description: The system's primary orbital city hangs above a cold factory world. .
name: Tokirev Habitat
short_desc: Utilitarian orbital city above a cold factory world.

description: Rim orbital that grew from a frontier stop into a regional hub. Industry and new money sit side by side.
name: Fennet Habitat
short_desc: Rim orbital that grew from a frontier stop into a regional hub.

description: Polished orbital above a finance world. Banks, exchanges, and luxury suites look down on temperate farmland.
name: Fortuna Habitat
short_desc: Polished orbital above a finance world.

description: Mercantile orbital above an oceanic shipping hub. Old trading houses still set the tone.
name: New Carthage Habitat
short_desc: Mercantile orbital above an oceanic mercantile hub.

description: Spacious orbital above one of the galaxy's great population centres. Green belts show through the cloud.
name: Horizon Habitat
short_desc: Spacious orbital above a great population centre.

description: Low-gravity tourist orbital above Titania IX. Winter sports and spectacular skies sell the view.
name: Titania Habitat
short_desc: Low-gravity tourist orbital above Titania IX.

description: Commerce and manufacturing orbital above Pelagos. Twin suns make the daylight cycle a local sport.
name: Pelagos Habitat
short_desc: Commerce and manufacturing orbital above Pelagos.

description: Central mining habitat in the Alpha Centauri A asteroid belt. Ore convoys and refinery traffic share the lanes with Proxima-bound shuttles.
name: Centauri A Beltworks
short_desc: Mining habitat in the Alpha Centauri A belt.

description: Orbital support for magma-side surveys on Alpha Centauri B's inner world. Heat-shielded docks see constant ore assay traffic.
name: ACB1

description: Surface and orbital mining around Scar, the airless inner world of Alpha Centauri B. Convoys feed Proxima refineries.
name: Scar

description: Ice-harvest and assay habitat at the outer edge of Alpha Centauri B's planetary zone.
name: ACB3

description: Circumbinary outpost on the frozen giant Terminus. Supply runs from Proxima keep the deep-cold refineries fed.
name: Terminus

description: Heavily shielded observation habitat in orbit around the inner gas giant Vulcan. Instrument traffic only; no shipyard.
name: Vulcan Research Station

description: Central habitat for the asteroid belt beyond Tycho. Mining convoys and Tycho supply shuttles share the lanes.
name: Regulus Belt Station

description: Surface and orbital mining infrastructure on Denarius II, moon of the inner giant Denarius.
name: Denarius II
short_desc: Mining moon orbitals at Denarius II.

description: Unstable rocky moon of Typhon with surface and orbital mining. Tremor warnings are routine in the docking briefing.
name: Typhon XVI

description: Central habitat for the asteroid belt beyond Pelagos. Cooperative haulage and mining convoys share the lanes.
name: Pelagos Belt Station

description: Dedicated corporate orbital above the sector. Galactic Outcomes maintains its own docks.
name: Galactic Outcomes

description: Dedicated corporate orbital above the sector. GRC Inc maintains its own docks.
name: GRC Inc

description: Dedicated corporate orbital above the sector. Creus Corporation maintains its own docks.
name: Creus Corporation

description: Dedicated corporate orbital above the sector. SnedeCorp maintains its own docks.
name: SnedeCorp

description: Dedicated corporate orbital above the sector. Fellowship of Apex maintains its own docks.
name: Fellowship of Apex

description: Dedicated corporate orbital above the sector. General Industrial maintains its own docks.
name: General Industrial

description: Dedicated corporate orbital above the sector. Morrow & Sons maintains its own docks.
name: Morrow & Sons

description: Dedicated corporate orbital above the sector. The Octagon maintains its own docks.
name: The Octagon

description: Dedicated corporate orbital above the sector. Crown & Anchor maintains its own docks.
name: Crown & Anchor

description: Dedicated corporate orbital above the sector. Mercury Communications maintains its own docks.
name: Mercury Communications

description: Dedicated corporate orbital above the sector. Orion Aerospace maintains its own docks.
name: Orion Aerospace

description: Dedicated corporate orbital above the sector. Chimera Corporation maintains its own docks.
name: Chimera Corporation

description: Dedicated corporate orbital above the sector. Terra Nova maintains its own docks.
name: Terra Nova

description: Orbital docks above a dry inner world. Assay crews share the ring with hab-suit climbers heading for the low-G ranges.
name: Aurelia
short_desc: Mining and hab-suit tourism at Aurelia.

description: High-gravity mining orbitals above an icy super-Earth. Tourist traffic is scarce; ore convoys are not.
name: Boreas

description: Moon-orbiting resort beneath Calypso's rings. The parent giant fills the viewports.
name: Calypso VI

description: Small orbital station at the ice giant Hesper. The giant's magnetic field dominates local navigation briefs.
name: Hesper
short_desc: Orbital station at the ice giant Hesper.

description: Resort habitat orbiting the icy nucleus of the long-period comet Kestrel. Charter traffic follows the comet's approach toward Delta Pavonis.
name: Kestrel Resort
short_desc: Resort habitat at the comet Kestrel.

description: Orbital docks above Alecto's darkside. Automated mining convoys share the ring with supply traffic from Irasia.
name: Alecto

description: Sealed dome agriculture and chemical traffic orbit a dense greenhouse world. High-gravity haulers use the outer lanes.
name: New Ceres
short_desc: Greenhouse agriculture orbitals at New Ceres.

description: Central habitat for the rich asteroid belt beyond New Ceres. Crystal and chemical assay traffic never sleeps.
name: Virginis Asteroid Station
short_desc: Mining habitat in the Virginis belt.

description: Extraction orbitals above Varda III. Ice haulers and subsurface-ocean chemistry share the ring beneath Varda's silvery glow.
name: Varda III

description: Sparse belt beyond Varda. Smaller convoys than Virginis, but steady ore and ice traffic.
name: Varda Asteroid Station
short_desc: Mining habitat in the outer Virginis belt.

description: Lonely research station in orbit of cold Cressida. Cryovolcanic survey traffic uses the outer lanes.
name: Cressida Research Station

description: Multiple orbitals above Scoria's dark volcanic surface. Surface mining convoys share the ring with supply traffic from Tokirev.
name: Scoria

description: Central bases in the dense Ursa asteroid belt. Extraction traffic between Scoria and the gas giant never thins.
name: Ursa Belt Bases
short_desc: Mining bases in the Ursa belt.

description: Construction and testing yards embedded in the Ursa belt. Hull cradles and trial lanes share the approaches with ore haulers.
name: Ursa Belt Shipyard
short_desc: Belt shipyard between Scoria and Ursa.

description: Orbital docks above rocky Ursa XVI. Surface extraction traffic uses the outer lanes beneath the banded giant.
name: Ursa XVI

description: Sealed orbitals above methane oceans on Ursa XXIX. Chemical extraction and tanker traffic fill the ring.
name: Ursa XXIX

description: Remote observatory orbiting an icy Kuiper-belt object. Supply runs from the inner system are long and infrequent.
name: Long Drift Observatory

description: Orbitals above a nitrogen wasteland. Assay traffic for Junkers Emeralds shares the ring with surface mining convoys.
name: Junker's World

description: Small orbital on the high-albedo comet Swan. Opposed polar jets make the approaches lively; rare mineral work pays for the caution.
name: Swan
short_desc: Research and extraction orbital at Swan.

description: Automated infrastructure orbits the eccentric comet Freediver. Core extraction traffic thins when perihelion approaches.
name: Freediver

description: Research station orbiting icy Nostromo. Survey teams monitor the comet's unusual radioactive core.
name: Nostromo

description: Resort habitat on long-period comet Eternum. Charter traffic spikes when the nucleus swings back toward Fennet.
name: Eternum Resort

description: Orbitals above frozen Janus. Ice-bound mining convoys share the ring with assay traffic that rarely pays for the gravity tax.
name: Janus

description: Small orbital on Sapphire XVI. Frozen methane and chemical haulers use the outer lanes beneath the bluish gas giant.
name: Sapphire XVI

description: Mining orbital at Vesuvius V. Ore convoys depart under the turbulent colours of the parent gas giant.
name: Vesuvius V

description: Hub for the dense inner Tau Ceti debris band. Assay and convoy traffic never quite clears the approach lanes.
name: TC Inner Disc Station

description: Hub for the sparser outer debris disc. Lower density extraction still feeds Fortuna's markets.
name: TC Outer Disc Station

description: Isolated research station beyond the debris disc. Supply runs and survey teams are the regular traffic.
name: Terminary Research Station

description: Orbitals above Byrsa. Tidal yards and component traffic share the sky with New Carthage and 61 Cygni B.
name: Byrsa

description: Depot 61C in the inner asteroid belt. Convoy traffic never quite clears the approach lanes.
name: Depot 61C

description: Mining and energy orbital at Tanit XX. Warm subsurface work proceeds beneath the white-and-red bands of Tanit.
name: Tanit XX
short_desc: Mining and energy at Tanit XX.

description: Orbitals above dark Nightjar, third planet of 61 Cygni B. Surface mining convoys use the outer lanes.
name: Nightjar

description: Hub for the warm rare-element debris disc. Processing traffic never quite clears the approach lanes.
name: Alpha Disc Hub

description: Orbitals above the smooth ice moon The Cueball. Manufacturing, tourism, and ore traffic share the ring with gas giant B.
name: The Cueball

description: Halo Station rides a clear gap in the dusty rings of B. Research charters and tourism share the docks.
name: Halo Station

description: KB Station I anchors extraction in the outer planetesimal belt.
name: KB Station I

description: KB Station II serves the cold outer belt farther from Epsilon Eridani.
name: KB Station II

description: KB Station III is the outermost of the three belt hubs, on the edge of the swarm.
name: KB Station III

description: Nocturn Research Lab orbits a large outer-belt planetesimal. Supply runs are the regular traffic.
name: Nocturn Research Lab
